release_name: Live TV v5.6.2 (Build 71) — Picture-in-Picture & Floating Window Fix
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🖼️ Picture-in-Picture (PiP) Fixed Across All Platforms: Clicking the PiP button (or pressing P) on macOS now launches a floating always-on-top 16:9 mini-player with Play/Pause, Next/Prev Channel, Mute, drag-to-move, bottom-right 16:9 drag-to-resize, and one-click restore.
🌐 Web & Android PiP Parity: Seamless native OS PiP on Android and standard browser/Safari PiP on Web & iOS.
⭐ Default Favorites Channel Launch: Automatically opens directly in the Favorites channel section on startup across all 3 platforms (macOS, Android, and Web).
🪟 Native Multi-Window Experience: Open and watch unlimited independent floating windows simultaneously on macOS via ⌘N, Dock options, or in-app buttons.
👆 Click-to-Show Smart Player Controls: Moving the mouse cursor over the video no longer shows distracting quick buttons; click the video to toggle controls on/off.
